question: Why does the rule "Choose objects or data structures based on what changes" matter in a code review?

expected_rule_sections.heading: Choose objects or data structures based on what changes
heading_path: Clean Code, Chapter 12: Objects and Data Structures, PR review rules
Choose objects or data structures based on what changes

relevant_concepts: Choose objects or data structures based on what changes

Objects hide data and expose behavior, which makes new data types easier to add. Data structures expose data and use procedures, which makes new behavior easier to add. Choose the boundary that protects the more stable side from the more volatile side.
